title: Render / drift / budget (docs/packs.md Render overlay, Render-time notes; docs/bootstrap.md Q7; docs/profile.md size_budget)

steps.name: render-overlay-notes
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --out out; rc=$?; cat out/runtime/solo.md; tail -3 out/runtime/builder-lead.md; grep -h 'campaign-overlay' out/runtime/*.md; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -qxF 'Overlay solo brief for campaign/a02 (campaign A02).' out/runtime/solo.md && grep -qxF '## Render note: notes/lead.md' out/runtime/builder-lead.md && grep -q 'gh pr list --state open --campaign-overlay' out/runtime/builder.md && ! grep -rqE '<(owner|repo|state-dir|eng-crew|op:[a-z.-]+)>' out

steps.name: missing-mapping
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && cp pack/render/backends/github.toml map.orig && sed '/^list-open = /d' map.orig > pack/render/backends/github.toml && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --out out-bad > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat o.txt; cp map.orig pack/render/backends/github.toml; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'templates/runtimes/tmux/builder.md:[0-9]*: missing mapping: no command for change.list-open' o.txt && test ! -e out-bad

steps.name: missing-note
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && sed 's#notes/lead.md#notes/missing.md#' crew.toml > crew-missing.toml && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project crew-missing.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --out out-bad > o.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat o.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'notes/missing.md:1: cannot read runtime.options.notes.render.builder-lead file' o.txt && test ! -e out-bad

steps.name: drift-clean
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --out live > /dev/null && python3 {source}/scripts/check-skill-drift.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --live-dir live > o.txt; rc=$?; tail -1 o.txt; test $rc -eq 0

steps.name: drift-key-fact
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && cp live/runtime/builder.md builder.orig && sed 's/`crew:in-review`/`crew:in-progress`/' builder.orig > live/runtime/builder.md && python3 {source}/scripts/check-skill-drift.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --live-dir live > o.txt; rc=$?; grep -E 'DRIFT|drifted' o.txt; cp builder.orig live/runtime/builder.md; test $rc -eq 1 && grep -q 'runtime/builder.md: 1 section(s) drifted' o.txt

steps.name: drift-restored
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && python3 {source}/scripts/check-skill-drift.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --live-dir live > o.txt; rc=$?; tail -1 o.txt; test $rc -eq 0

steps.name: long-install-path
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && sed 's#/campaign-a02/#/campaign-a02/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/very-long-install-root-segment/#' crew.toml > crew-long.toml && python3 {source}/scripts/crew-render.py --project crew-long.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --out out-long && grep -c 'very-long-install-root-segment' out-long/runtime/builder.md && grep -q 'very-long-install-root-segment' out-long/runtime/builder.md

steps.name: budget-tests
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && python3 {source}/scripts/test-crew-bootstrap.py -k size_budget 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 {source}/scripts/test-crew-bootstrap.py -k size_budget > /dev/null 2>&1

steps.name: render-parity-tests
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && for t in test-crew-render.py test-render-parity.py test-crew-bootstrap.py; do python3 {source}/scripts/$t > o-$t.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "$t exit $rc: $(tail -1 o-$t.txt)"; test $rc -eq 0 || exit 1; done

steps.name: drift-altered-live
steps.run: cd {state_dir}/a02 && sed 's/--campaign-overlay/--edited-live/' builder.orig > live/runtime/builder.md && python3 {source}/scripts/check-skill-drift.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --live-dir live > o1.txt; r1=$?; cp builder.orig live/runtime/builder.md; printf 'Injected live-only instruction.\n' >> live/runtime/builder.md && python3 {source}/scripts/check-skill-drift.py --project crew.toml --org-profile pack/profile.toml --live-dir live > o2.txt; r2=$?; cp builder.orig live/runtime/builder.md; echo "altered command: exit $r1"; grep -E 'builder.md|WORDING|DRIFT|^OK' o1.txt; echo "appended text: exit $r2"; grep -E 'builder.md|WORDING|DRIFT|^OK' o2.txt; test $r1 -eq 1 && test $r2 -eq 1
